Traffic Advisory 

In view of traffic management on Nangloi–Najafgarh Road, the following traffic diversions will be implemented today on 09.03.2026  to ensure smooth flow of traffic and to manage traffic efficiency. Commuters are advised to plan their journey accordingly and follow the directions of traffic police personnel deployed on the road.

 TRAFFIC DIVERSION :

 Commuters coming from Najafgarh side towards Nangloi on Nangloi–Najafgarh Road :

* Traffic will be diverted at Vikas Nagar Cut towards Vikas Nagar .

 Commuters coming from Nangloi Chowk towards Najafgarh on Nangloi–Najafgarh Road :

* Traffic will be diverted from Nangloi Chowk towards Rohtak Road .

Commuters are requested to cooperate with traffic police and use alternate routes to avoid inconvenience. 

#DPTrafficAdvisory

data.raw_text:
Walkthrough ❌ Moonwalk ✅

Sa video na ibinahagi mismo ni Pasig City Mayor Vico Sotto, makikita ang alkaldeng tila naglalakad at umiikot sa loob ng E. Santos Health Center, ngunit ang totoo ay gumamit lamang siya ng backdrop video.

“Tara pasok tayo! Ito yung bagong health center sa E. Santos,” saad ni Sotto sa unang bahagi ng video.

Komento naman ng netizens, “Pov: May ocular visit ka pero work from home.”

Samantala, ang bagong health center na may ₱13.5 milyong budget ay mayroon nang tatlong palapag, kumpleto sa CCTV at fire safety system, at pasok sa Department of Health (DOH) standards. (via Bea Tanierla)

#PilipinasToday
#VicoSotto
#PasigCity #VirtualTour
